steps.description: Diagnose the root cause: deployment/product-catalog is configured to pull a non-existent image tag (app-image:latest), causing ImagePullBackOff and upstream checkout timeouts (per IncorrectImage.root_cause / diagnosis_oracle expected description).
Patch the product-catalog deployment's container image from app-image:latest to the correct image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.0.2-productcatalogservice.
Run the mitigation oracle: fetch the deployment and confirm the container image is no longer app-image:latest (IncorrectImageMitigationOracle.evaluate()).
